title: 第2105章 大荒杳杳无人间雪林深处藏人家第2104章 但行好事莫问前程
content_zh:
霜雪落大荒，千山万林皆染白，苍茫世界，杳无人烟。
这里已是大荒深处，千年前的古镇村落，已变成了历史的尘埃，平阔江流之地，曾是人族祖辈栖居之地，可自从剑王朝覆灭，最后的人皇躲在大荒魂荒村之后，人族最后的瑰宝之地也回归了自然本来的面貌。
林深古道，青砖石条，枯叶堆积，覆盖在厚雪之下。
这一日，这片林深妖踞之地，迎来了人族少年的身影，他御空而来，身披一件雪白色的大氅，完美地与天地融合在一起。
一个人的人间，天地皆静，青丝白发的极致写意，又何尝不是一种孤独？
少年也未曾想到，当年一心只想和心爱姑娘天涯漂泊的他，有一天会为弱势的人族奔走。
当顾余生在大荒深处看见数十处生活在山林深处的人家时，终于明白所谓背剑人，并不是守护人皇的门楣，也不是背着剑向世人传递正义。
行走于黑暗，也不是披星赶月。
当天下人都不为时，守住最后的一道希冀之光。
天妖城离西州尚近，凡人渡临江口后，尚有进入人族领地的希望，但万妖城实在离人族领地太远太远了，远到顾余生于天地间奔走，也感觉到小玄界并不小，只是人族生存的地方被挤压，所以不够广阔。
一个人独行，思维会变得如天空大地一样广阔。
一座山到另外一座山，足已困住凡人的一生，顾余生记得师父秦酒，在成为背剑人后，几乎都在大荒行走，也总是那般疲惫。
原来他身心的疲惫，并不是与妖族战斗，而是无数人被困在了大山深处。
他们的一生走不出来，祖祖辈辈。
与妖斗。
何尝不是与天斗？
夜幕降临，山林雪深，平阔大荒，山林水抱之地，袅袅几缕炊烟自崖洞飘荡出来，山洞外下平阔的栈道，几盆火油燃着。
人在很远的地方，就可以看见。
御空数日未与人相遇的顾余生，看见烟火气出，心神微动，从高空遁下，落在炊烟飘荡的山脚下。
一泓泉水从山上流下，落在石头上发出击玉佩鸣之音，极寒之天，泉水氤氲蒸腾，天赐一河温暖之流，暖流化开两岸平阔之地，精耕细护的田亩引渠延伸，大地如人，经脉通畅，白菜、青菜在稻草人中间顶着雪帽，像一个个俏皮可爱的孩子。

暖泉河边青石铺就，被岁月的雨水刷得干干净净，往上走，悬崖陡峭，路开在两山一线之间，上面悬着一个一个的大石头。
每一个石头砸下来，都能够将路完美地封住。
顾余生抬头，看见几个孩子探头探脑，目光触及的刹那，那几个孩子的眼睛泛着光亮，有警惕，有胆怯，片刻后，一个小孩忽然大声欢呼着跑进崖洞：
“阿爹，阿爹，有人，有人来！”
“阿娘，阿爷，有人来，快看，有人来！”
脆生生的声音里，带着浓浓的兴奋，不一会，上方的崖道上，探头探脑孩子们的后面，先伸出来几个壮实男子的身影，再有几名穿着朴素的女子也探出头。
“他爹，真是外乡人。”
“退后退后。”
男人们把好奇的女人护至身后，有人躲在石头两边，随时可以拉动石头封住上山的路，更有一名老翁悄悄取出一面铜镜，偷偷往顾余生身上照。
“年轻人，从哪里来？忘忧村还是蝴蝶谷？”说话的是一位精神矍铄的老人，他拄着拐杖来，其他人眼里带着尊敬。
content_en:
Frost and snow have fallen on the vast wilderness, thousands of mountains and forests are all dyed white, and the vast world is deserted.
This place is already deep in the wilderness, and the ancient towns and villages from thousands of years ago have turned into the dust of history. The land of flat rivers was once the place where the ancestors of the human race lived. But since the fall of the Sword Dynasty and the last human emperor hiding in the deserted soul village of the great wilderness, the last treasure land of the human race has returned to its original appearance of nature.
The ancient road is deep in the forest, with blue bricks and stone strips, piles of dead leaves, and covered under thick snow.
On this day, this land of deep forests and monsters ushered in the figure of a human boy. He came from the sky, wearing a snow-white cloak, perfectly blending with the heaven and earth.
In a world where one is alone, the world is quiet, and one's black hair and black hair are perfectly freehand. Isn't it a kind of loneliness?
The young man never imagined that he, who only wanted to wander around the world with his beloved girl, would one day work for the weak human race.
When Gu Yusheng saw dozens of families living deep in the mountains and forests in the depths of the wilderness, he finally understood that the so-called sword-carrying people were not protecting the lintel of the Emperor, nor were they carrying swords to deliver justice to the world.
Walking in the darkness is not like chasing the moon under the stars.
When no one in the world does anything, hold on to the last light of hope.
Tianyao City is still close to Xizhou. Mortals can still hope to enter the human territory after crossing the river mouth. However, Wanyao City is really too far away from the human territory. It is so far that Gu Yusheng was running between heaven and earth. He also felt that the Mysterious Little World was not small. It was just that the place where the human race lived was squeezed, so it was not broad enough.
When a person walks alone, his mind becomes as vast as the sky and the earth.
Going from one mountain to another is enough to trap a mortal for a lifetime. Gu Yusheng remembered his master Qin Jiu. After becoming a sword-carrying man, he almost walked in the wilderness and was always so tired.
It turned out that his physical and mental exhaustion was not due to fighting the monsters, but because countless people were trapped deep in the mountains.
They can't get out of their lives, and their ancestors have been here for generations.
Fight with monsters.
Isn't it a fight with the sky?
As night falls, there is deep snow in the mountains and forests, a vast wilderness, a land surrounded by mountains, forests and water. A few wisps of smoke drift from the cliff cave, and a few pots of kerosene are burning on the flat plank road outside the cave.
People can see it from far away.
Gu Yusheng, who had not met anyone in Yukong for several days, saw the smoke coming out of the fireworks, and his heart moved slightly. He escaped from the high altitude and landed at the foot of the mountain where the smoke was floating.
A stream of spring water flows down from the mountain, falling on the rocks and making a jingling sound. On an extremely cold day, the spring water is steaming, and God has given the river a warm flow. The warm flow opens up the flat land on both sides, and the intensively cultivated acres of land lead to canals. The earth is like a human being, with smooth meridians. Cabbages and green vegetables are wearing snow caps among the scarecrows, like naughty and cute children.
The bluestone paved by the Nuanquan River has been washed clean by the rains of the years. Going up, the cliff is steep, and the road opens between the two mountains, with large rocks hanging on it.
Every stone dropped can seal the road perfectly.
Gu Yusheng raised his head and saw several children poking their heads. The moment they looked at each other, the children's eyes were shining brightly, some were alert and some were timid. A moment later, a child suddenly ran into the cliff cave cheering loudly:
"Abba, Abba, someone is here, someone is coming!"
"Grandma, Grandpa, someone is coming, look, someone is coming!"
There was a strong excitement in the crisp voice. After a while, on the cliff path above, people poked their heads behind the children. First, the figures of several strong men stuck out, and then a few women in simple clothes also stuck their heads out.
"His father is really a foreigner."
"Back off, back off."
The men protected the curious woman behind them. Some were hiding on both sides of the stone, ready to pull the stone to block the way up the mountain. There was even an old man who quietly took out a bronze mirror and secretly took a look at Gu Yusheng.
"Young man, where do you come from? Wangyou Village or Butterfly Valley?" The speaker was a vigorous old man, who came with a cane. The others had respect in their eyes.。
